label: managerial or political leadership in
definition: Person 1 holds or formerly held a managerial or political leadership office in organization/body 2.
scope_notes: Chair, president, executive, head, director, chief and political leader qualify. Founder/owner alone does not. Historical offices qualify. Direction person to organization.

facts.reason: Republicans control the House, but this is a party-to-legislature control relation, not a person holding a leadership office.
Lay is explicitly chairman, executive and leader of Enron.
Greenspan is explicitly chairman of the Federal Reserve, including tenure as chairman.
Greenberg is explicitly executive, chairman and president of American International Group.
Edwards died in Sarasota; this is a death location rather than organizational leadership.
